summary: Studio Bagno’s Wall Faced Pans are designed to recede elegantly into their surrounds, concealing the cistern behind the wall, offering a more streamlined wall / floor silhouette.
title: Built For Performance. Styled To Impress - Wall Faced Pans
bodyHtml:
Milady Wall Faced Pan in Matte Black

Subtle Sophistication & Performance

In the pursuit of refined simplicity, wall faced pans—often referred to as floor mount pans—offer a minimalist solution for bathrooms where clean lines, subtle design and considered functionality matter most.

Studio Bagno presents a carefully curated collection of floor mount pans to suit a wide variety of architectural styles, from crisp contemporary through to enduringly classic.


Synthesis Eco in Matte White by Olympia Ceramica - 360 x 520 x 420 mm

Design without Disruption

Ideal for projects seeking a streamlined and minimalist aesthetic, the wall faced pan sits seamlessly against the wall, concealing the cistern and allowing visual continuity throughout the space.

Particularly well-suited to smaller bathrooms or powder rooms, their compact footprint enhances spatial flow without compromising on performance.


Manhattan Wall Faced Pan - 365 x 520 x 420 mm

High Performance Flush, Built-In Hygiene

When paired with our exclusive Oli In-Wall Cisterns, each model features high-performance rimless flush systems—WELS 4-star rated—and undergo rigorous performance testing to ensure both water efficiency and splash reduction.

Further more, all our toilets come standard with CleanMax Anti-Bacterial Technology Glaze, which incorporates a special formulation to reduce the growth of harmful bacteria.

This innovative technology creates a permanent, self-sanitizing surface, helping to keep your toilet cleaner for longer.


Impero Wall Faced Pan paired with Impero Flush Plate - 390 x 550 x 425 mm

Pair Effortlessly

Selecting the right in-wall cistern to complement your floor mount pan should be simple and seamless. To ensure an effortless experience, we offer expertly curated cistern and toilet packages tailored for each of our floor mount pans.

These packages eliminate any guesswork, guaranteeing perfect compatibility, optimal performance, and a streamlined installation process for both residential and commercial applications.
